author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Rebuilt as the reference's 3D oblique sponge block (top, front and right faces) resting in suds: two bubbles over the lower-left front corner and a puddle with a rounded right end under the block. Replaces the flat rounded bar and separate foam blob. Reads at 48 in both themes; block kept slightly taller than the reference so the bubbles clear the top-face edges by 8+.
